findings.highlight: I know who you really are, so you can't fool me with that overachiever image.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない
findings.governingReading: 本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない says the disguise is so convincing it might fool even him.
findings.explanation: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.
